description: This file defines an interface for a service that checks if savings are mapped to a user within the Fineract project. It contains a single method for this purpose.

classes.name: AppuserSavingsMapperReadService
classes.description: Interface for reading the mapping status of savings accounts to application users.

methods.name: isSavingsMappedToUser
methods.description: Checks if a specific savings account is mapped to a specific user.
